title: Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts: Reliability Credit for Recent Paid Batches in Drop Disputes
content:
**Clause.** When a Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts shopper disputes a dropped-batch violation, the reliability credit counts the batches for which the shopper was paid base pay less than one whole month before the dispute: 10 or more give a reliability credit of 2 points; from 5 up to 9 (one fewer than 10) give 1 point; fewer give no credit.

The count comes from the shopper's batch pay ledger in Cartwise Shopper Batches: each batch-base pay posting dated less than one whole month before the day of the dispute counts once. Postings of other pay components do not count.

| Batches paid base pay in the month before the dispute | Reliability credit |
|---|---|
| 10 or more | 2 points |
| 5 to 9 | 1 point |
| 0 to 4 | None |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical ledgers)

- 10 base-pay postings in the month: 2 points; 9: 1 point.
- 5 postings: 1 point; 4: none.
- 7 postings in the month and 30 more from earlier months: only the 7 count — 1 point.
